title: add benchmark-lab multi-variant reporting pipeline v41
author: Priya Nambiar
release_notes: Adds multi-variant reporting pipeline (v41) for Benchmark Lab. Improves aggregation across profiling baselines and representative runners, and adds CI checks for nightly runs.
description:
Context: Benchmark Lab needs a consolidated multi-variant reporting pipeline that can ingest profiling baselines and representative workload runs and produce per-variant performance and regression reports. This PR implements v41 of the reporting pipeline and wires it into CI so nightly and on-demand runs produce consistent artifacts for dashboards and alerts.

Motivation: Recent work on profiling baselines (ENG-4982) and representative runners (ENG-5010) introduced multiple runner variants and output formats. v41 normalizes outputs, computes aggregated metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, token throughput, memory deltas) per-variant/model/hardware and uploads artifacts to the benchmark artifacts bucket. This enables cross-variant comparisons, automated regression detection, and easier ingestion by the observability pack.

What changed (high level):
- New pipeline definition: benchmark-lab/pipelines/reporting_v41.yaml (Argo) that coordinates ingestion, normalization, metric aggregation and artifact upload.
- Runner updates: benchmark-lab/runners/multi_variant_runner.py adds normalization hooks for variant metadata and KV-cache-aware parsing.
- Aggregation utilities: benchmark-lab/aggregator/metrics_v2.py (adds weighted throughput and stable percentiles).
- CI: .github/workflows/benchmark-reporting.yml updated to schedule nightly v41 runs and add a lightweight smoke job on PRs.
- Docs: docs/benchmark-lab.md updated with v41 pipeline diagram and runbook.

Testing: Unit tests for normalization and aggregation added under benchmark-lab/tests. End-to-end staging run executed against sample artifacts bucket (staging) and outputs validated with the existing dashboard ingestion scripts.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps runner-side output compatibility for older pipelines; v41 is opt-in via pipeline name to avoid disrupting ongoing experiments.

Related: ENG-4982, ENG-5010, SUP-3214.
